[first battle generation, last, text] ranges, 0 being Champions battles (generations 1-2 have no abilities); edited from the text-summary-en.json (PokeRogue) descriptions after Pokémon Showdown's (MIT) per-generation ability notes and data and PokéTale's engine
aerilate: The Pokémon’s Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and their power is boosted by 30%.
arenatrap: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing or switching out.
ballfetch: The Pokémon fetches Poké Balls, but this has no effect in battle.
battlebond: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted. This works only once per battle.
If a Greninja has this Ability, it transforms into Ash-Greninja when it knocks out a target. Its Water Shuriken then always hits three times with 20 power per hit.

commander: Upon entering battle, the Pokémon goes inside an ally Dondozo if one is on the field and raises all of Dondozo’s stats sharply.
cutecharm: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 1/3 chance of becoming infatuated if the attacker and the Pokémon are of opposite genders.
dauntlessshield: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

disguise: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.
drizzle: Summons rain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The rain lasts until the weather changes. Powers up Water-type moves by 50% and halves the damage of Fire-type moves.
drought: Summons harsh sunlight when the Pokémon enters a battle. The harsh sunlight lasts until the weather changes. Powers up Fire-type moves by 50% and halves the damage of Water-type moves.
effectspore: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 10% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep.
When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep.
electricsurge: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. Pokémon on the ground have their Electric-type moves boosted by 50% and cannot be put to sleep.
flamebody: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 1/3 chance of being burned.
frisk: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon’s held item.
galewings: Increases the priority of the Pokémon’s Flying-type moves by 1 stage.
grassysurge: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle. Pokémon on the ground have their Grass-type moves boosted by 50% and restore 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn.
hadronengine: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when entering a battle, which powers up the Electric-type moves of Pokémon on the ground by 50% and prevents them from falling asleep. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.
healer: The Pokémon has a 30% chance of curing the status conditions of its allies at the end of every turn.
honeygather: The Pokémon gathers Honey, but this has no effect in battle.
iceface: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it begins to snow or hail.
illuminate: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered and ignores changes to targets’ evasiveness.
